Trump on North Korea:

I get along great with Kim Jong Un of North Korea. When people have 112 nuclear missiles, it's nice to get along.

But here's the difference: Iran will never have a nuclear missile. https://t.co/6iBUH8VXOs

Trump:

Xi got off the plane, and he said, "Boy, have you done a job. Wow!" They can't believe it. https://t.co/r29JHitjE8

Trump:

Somebody said, "Why is he being nice to Xi?" Isn't it nice to get along with the leaders of massive nuclear nations? https://t.co/iNdK9bCtJQ
